title: Operator: pure 24h execution status count aggregator

investigation.trigger: standing instruction to keep shipping real, tested improvements to the Command Hub Operator Console
investigation.target: new pure function summarizing dev_autopilot_executions status counts over a 24h window, intended for later wiring into an Operator Console tool
investigation.design_decision: dynamic status-keyed output rather than a hardcoded fixed status enum with zero-fill, to avoid drifting from the real dev_autopilot_executions CHECK constraint's value set (which this repo's own CLAUDE.md CHANGE LOG shows has grown over time) — the same duplicated-enum anti-pattern VTID-03644/VTID-03696 already paid for once each

fix.mechanism: pure function, no DB access, no existing callers

verification.regression_sweep: not applicable — new file, zero existing callers or naming collisions, confirmed via grep across services/gateway/src

live_verification: not applicable — pure function with no DB access and no tool wiring yet; nothing to observe live
